Both checks pass. `registry.sh validate` shows duplicate, tr_unknown, path_missing, status and layout all 0. The `yaml.safe_load` check on the three files prints ok. Entity counts are 1143 entities, 1139 TRs and 140 architecture entries.

I edited only the three allowed files. Line endings are preserved: tr-registry and entities are LF, architecture.yaml is CRLF as in the worktree. A line-ending slip partway through was reverted.

## Counts (the 65 requests)
- **tr-registry.yaml:** 40 requests applied, 4 declined, 1 merged into the tr_rewords batch.
- **architecture.yaml:** 3 applied, 1 partly applied, 12 declined.
- **entities.yaml:** 11 applied, 5 declined.

Some requests span more than one registry or merge into each other, so these counts do not add up to exactly 65.

## What I applied
- **tr-registry.yaml:**
  - Reworded 40 entries, each with `revised: 2026-10-29`.
  - Added `TR-webmap-047`, appended after `TR-webmap-046`. It is the new `web.state` requirement for `pod_arrived_seq` and `berthed_seq`.
  - Set `last_updated` to 2026-10-29.
- **architecture.yaml:**
  - `keyed_rng` now names `Ihash.h32` (Attention beat jitter, non-zero HASH_SEED, attention `hash32` retired).
  - `state_hash_function` now records the golden `0x81AB3842EF1E8DEF`.
  - `dirty_key_encoding` now says a raise above the sized capacity is refused as `KNOB_REFUSED`.
  - Each edit keeps the old value in a `# was` comment and sets `revised`.
- **entities.yaml:**
  - Updated `HASH_SEED`, `BEAT_JITTER_TICKS`, `RESTORE_KEY_STRIDE`, `MAX_DIRTY_KEYS` and the `DIAG_P99_MIN_SAMPLES` variables text (it now says a CONTENT_INVARIANT refuses the load, ranges are guidance).
  - Removed `failure-and-trail-system.md` from `rng_derive.referenced_by`.
  - Added constants `MAX_SUBSCRIPTIONS` (96), `MAX_EVENTS_PER_TICK` (64), `AUDIT_EVERY_TICK`, `SALT_BEAT`, `TRAIL_VIS_SEED` and `SALT_TRAIL_VIS`. The values of `SALT_BEAT`, `TRAIL_VIS_SEED` and `SALT_TRAIL_VIS` are left as unfixed placeholders. `HASH_SEED` is still unfixed.

## Declined or not needed
- **architecture.yaml, already reflected:** these needed no edit, because the registry already carried the ADR text:
  - `request_restore` signature and the snapshot ControlOutcome fields
  - the `slot_epoch_a/b` pair
  - `RESTORE_KEY_STRIDE` and `draw_epoch`
  - the DICT key order and s64/u64 fold
  - the `IntMath` location
  - `body.projector` and `Camera2D.limit_*`
  - the layer indices, `D_root` 63/93 and `snap_baseline`
- **`referenced_by` for the attention and life-support-graph requests:** declined. In this file `referenced_by` lists ADR paths only, and GDD consumers go in `consumers:`. `attention-system` is already a `keyed_rng` consumer.
- **Not recorded in architecture.yaml, so nothing to update:**
  - the Body `restore_reject_reasons` / `ctx.fault` contract
  - the `web_events` consumers and the Attention/Horror read-only use of `web.state`
  - the kernel knobs. I recorded them in entities.yaml instead.
- **hud_tuning invariant names:** declined. The names are provisional until the schema story lands, and ADR-0007 section 2.5 says a new invariant is a schema change reviewed with its owner.
- **The `TR-pxl-006/007/008/009/017/018` and `TR-webmap-023` ADR-tag requests:** declined. `tr-registry.yaml` has no ADR-tag field, and `tr-baseline.md` already carries the re-tags.
- **entities.yaml, not recorded there:**
  - the HASH_DRIFT / owner-published `block_hash` wording
  - `SANITY_RESTORE_REASONS`, which has no return-signature text
  - `MAX_DECODE_NODES`
  - the `SL_*` reason sets
  - `D_root` and `D_composite`
- **Attention beat and tell-draw formula entries:** none exist in entities.yaml. I put the new `Ihash.h32` form and the `draw_epoch` note in `BEAT_JITTER_TICKS` and `HASH_SEED`.
- **requirements-traceability.md:** the `TR-charttable-036` and `TR-pc-027` row edits are not done, because I was restricted to the three registry files.
- **Not done, needs a caller decision:** the extra `tr-baseline.md` edits for `pc-027` and `suit-009` are likewise outside the three files.

## tr_rewords
All 30 entries are reworded and none still contradicts its ADR. I grepped each GDD and confirmed it already carried the synced wording. The entries are `cmd-004/018/040`, `lsg-021/022/023`, `pxl-002/014/015/025/030`, `emitter-032/038`, `pc-027/039`, `suit-009`, `section-033`, `shipbody-009`, `attention-024`, `sanity-001/020`, `hud-026`, `saveload-003/017/020/033`, `debug-033/044` and `charttable-036`.

Beyond the list I also reworded these request-driven entries:
- `pxl-010` and `pxl-028`, copied from the `tr-baseline.md` wording
- `emitter-034`
- `suit-030`
- `section-006`
- `shipbody-032`
- `ftrail-044`, which still said `rng_derive`, so I changed it to the `Ihash.h` form
- `assembly-013` and `assembly-030`

The GDD checks were spot greps for the key terms, not a full read of each section.
